Technique studies · index

Thirty-three read plates: one reference, one technique system, one rebuild each.

Each plate rebuilds a reference's technique in code, reads it with ten numbered points, compares it against the reference (R), and publishes its parameters as JSON (S). Match is the plate's optical-match readout — global statistics, composition-independent.
